name: Omareel
author: hadijaveed
description: Loom-style screen recording for Omarchy: record an area, window, or screen with a webcam bubble and your chosen mic, clean up the audio, upload to R2/S3/B2, and copy a share link. Floating controls while recording plus a bar launcher with in-widget settings.

barWidget.description: Record button with a live timer; opens the Omareel launcher and settings.
